stories.title: Philippinen – Banga National High School: Drei Tote nach Schüssen an Schule

en.title: Philippines – Banga National High School: Three dead after shots fired at school
en.summary: A student opened fire at a high school in a southern Philippine province, killing multiple people and injuring several others. The death toll may continue to rise.

en.title: Beck: "They just came onto my property and cut down my trees"
en.summary: Beck discusses recent events including the Los Angeles fires, conditions in Paris, and his songwriting approach in an interview.

en.title: Faction meeting: Greens demand high-tech energy agenda
en.summary: The Green Party faction is calling for a high-tech focused energy policy.

en.title: Berlin election: CDU and Left compete for the Red Town Hall
en.summary: The CDU and Left Party are nearly tied in polls but offer opposing solutions to Berlin's housing crisis as they compete for control of city government.

en.title: Football National Team: Watzke warns before Klopp debut: 'First just play'
en.summary: A football official cautions ahead of a coach's debut, emphasizing the importance of focusing on performance in upcoming matches.

en.summary: A fatal collision occurred in North Thuringia when a police patrol vehicle struck a cyclist.

en.summary: Russia transferred control of Nestlé and Auchan's business operations to a Russian company for state administration. Nestlé stated it intends to protect its rights.

stories.title: Putin stellt Nestlé in Russland unter Zwangsverwaltung

en.title: Putin places Nestlé under state administration in Russia
en.summary: Russian President Putin has issued a decree placing Nestlé's Russian operations under state administration. The Swiss food company continued production in Russia following the outbreak of the Ukraine war.

en.title: Germany Live Blog: New poll shows SPD ahead of AfD in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
en.summary: A new survey indicates the SPD leads the AfD in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern ahead of upcoming state elections. The blog covers multiple German political developments and reports of fraud losses at the GIZ in Yemen.

en.title: Urbach in Thuringia: Police vehicle hits cyclist
en.summary: A 35-year-old cyclist on an e-bike was struck by a police car on a road in northern Thuringia and died from injuries sustained in the accident.

en.title: News blog on state elections: Poll shows SPD overtakes AfD in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
en.summary: The SPD leads the AfD by one percentage point in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern according to the latest Politbarometer Extra poll. The CDU continues declining and approaches the five-percent electoral threshold.

en.title: Taxes: Do citizens trust a pre-filled tax return?
en.summary: Hesse has significantly expanded its pilot program where the tax authority completes tax returns for citizens. While the initiative reduces administrative work, many citizens remain skeptical about the approach.

en.summary: The EU is providing Ukraine with 3.3 billion euros for military equipment. Additional developments include potential US military base discussions with Poland and reports of Russian drone attacks on Ukrainian infrastructure.

en.summary: AI creators are warning about risks from their own developments, including existential threats to humanity. Incident protocols suggest failures in oversight and indicate what precautions may be necessary.

en.summary: A photographic collection showcases compelling images from around the world that inspire, provoke emotion, fascinate, and document significant moments alongside smaller wonders and stories.

stories.title: Geldpolitik: Japans Notenbank erhöht Leitzins auf höchsten Stand seit 31 Jahren

en.title: Monetary Policy: Bank of Japan Raises Key Rate to Highest Level in 31 Years
en.summary: Japan's central bank raised its key interest rate to the highest level in 31 years in response to increasing inflation risks. Stock markets reacted with surprise, and the yen initially moved contrary to expectations.
